title: Add RAG agent examples, tool-calling quickstarts, and docs site updates
author: Samir Patel
description: This PR adds a set of RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) agent templates, new tool-calling examples, short quickstarts for developers, and corresponding docs site updates. Motivation: provide reproducible examples and copy-pasteable quickstarts for users adopting agents + tool-calling with Redwood runtime; reduce friction when experimenting with RAG patterns and orchestrating external tools. Changes include: 1) example repo additions (redwood-examples/rag-agent-samples) with 3 agent templates (faq-bot, sales-assistant, code-assistant) that demonstrate: document ingestion, embeddings/semantic search, chain-of-thought prompting, and tool-calling hooks; 2) new quickstart guide in redwood-docs/docs/agents/tool-calling-quickstart.md with step-by-step instructions, minimal config, and a small test dataset; 3) updated docs site navigation and sidebars to surface the new quickstarts; 4) TypeScript and Python sample clients under redwood-examples/clients for launching agents and consuming streaming tool-calls; 5) a small e2e test harness for CI that runs a smoke test against the hosted dev environment. Checklist: - [x] Add RAG agent templates and example data - [x] Tool-calling examples for fetch/exec/kv-store integrations - [x] Quickstart docs and code snippets - [x] Docs site sidebar + search index update - [x] Unit + e2e smoke tests - [x] Changelog/release notes entry Testing: local lint + unit tests + CI smoke run against staging endpoint (passes). See linked Linear tasks for rollout plan and public doc schedule. Notes: kept example model sizes small to avoid quota issues; examples use model aliases and fallbacks so they work with both hosted and dedicated deployments. This is intended as docs + examples only; no runtime code changes to serving runtime were introduced.
